extra_prompt: You are booking for a licensed plumbing company. Ask whether the property is residential or commercial, and what the problem is. If the caller reports a gas smell, tell them to leave the building, avoid switches and flames, and call the gas emergency number for their area before we dispatch; treat it as an emergency. For burst pipes or flooding, tell the caller to isolate the water at the main if it is safe. Confirm the property has a current gas safety certificate where one is required.

kb.q: Are you licensed?
kb.a: Our plumbers hold [licence type] under licence number [your licence number]. Ask us for a copy before you book.

kb.q: Do you charge a callout fee?
kb.a: Yes. {callout_note} Ask us to confirm the callout fee when you book.

kb.q: How much does it cost to fix a leaking tap?
kb.a: {price_note} Tap repairs vary by tap type and the parts needed. We can give you an exact figure after a quick look at the tap.

kb.q: Do you offer emergency service?
kb.a: Yes. {emergency_note} We attend burst pipes, gas leaks, flooding and sewage backups, and we confirm the arrival time when you call.

kb.q: Can you replace a water heater today?
kb.a: A water heater replacement can sometimes be completed the same day, but only if the right unit is available. Call us with the make and size of your system so we can check stock and tell you the likely timing.

kb.q: What payment methods do you accept?
kb.a: We accept [your payment methods, for example cash, card or bank transfer]. Your invoice shows the payment terms and how to pay.

kb.q: Are you insured for commercial work?
kb.a: Our commercial work is covered by [insurer name and liability cover amount]. Ask us for a certificate of currency before we start.

kb.q: Do you fix blocked drains?
kb.a: Yes, we clear blocked drains with power rods and high-pressure jetting. Drain clearing is priced per line, and we confirm the method after looking at the blockage.

kb.q: How long does a bathroom remodel plumbing job take?
kb.a: Plumbing rough-in for a full bathroom usually takes [number] days, and fitting follows after tiling. We confirm the full schedule with you once the build plan is agreed.

kb.q: Do you service my area?
kb.a: Give us your postcode and we will confirm our coverage for your address. We cover [your service area, for example the metro area and listed outer suburbs].

kb.q: Do you install tankless water heaters?
kb.a: Yes, we install and service tankless and heat-pump water heaters. Pricing depends on the gas line and venting requirements, so we give you a quote after a site check.

kb.q: What causes low water pressure?
kb.a: Common causes are a partially closed valve, a failing pressure regulator, or scale buildup. A quick diagnostic usually shows which one is causing the problem.

kb.q: Can you fix a running toilet?
kb.a: Yes, a running toilet is usually a flapper, fill valve or float issue. Parts are quoted separately, and the repair is normally a short visit.

kb.q: Do you provide written estimates?
kb.a: Yes, we give a written estimate before work begins. We do not charge beyond the estimate without your approval.

kb.q: What happens if the repair doesn't work?
kb.a: {warranty_note} If the same issue returns, tell us and we will look at it again.

kb.q: Can I speak to a plumber directly before booking?
kb.a: Yes, if you want to talk it through first, we can arrange for a plumber to call you back. Tell us the best time to call when you enquire.

kb.q: Do you do gas fitting?
kb.a: Gas work is carried out by [licensed gas fitter name and licence number]. A gas compliance certificate is issued on completion where it is required.

kb.q: Are weekend appointments available?
kb.a: Weekend hours are [your Saturday hours]. Sunday and public holiday availability is [your Sunday and public holiday policy].

kb.q: Can you install a new dishwasher or washing machine?
kb.a: Yes, we install and connect appliance plumbing, including dishwashers and washing machines. Bring us the model number so we can confirm the fittings before the visit.

kb.q: Do you fix water leaks inside walls?
kb.a: Yes. Wall leaks usually need a small access cut. We locate the leak with moisture detection first so we cut as little as possible.

kb.q: Do you install a new toilet?
kb.a: Yes. We supply and install standard and wall-hung toilets. We check the waste pipe and floor before fitting, and the toilet price is quoted with the supply.

kb.q: Do you do a plumbing inspection before buying a home?
kb.a: Yes. A pre-purchase plumbing inspection checks visible pipes, taps, drains, hot water and water pressure. We give you a written report on what we find.

kb.q: How do I turn off my water in an emergency?
kb.a: Find the main isolation valve, usually near the water meter or where the pipe enters the house. Turn it clockwise until it stops, then call us to book the repair.

kb.q: Do you do bathroom renovation plumbing?
kb.a: Yes. We rough in and connect showers, baths, basins and toilets for renovations. We coordinate with the tiler and builder so the work runs in the right order.

compliance.guidance: Confirm the licence class and registration that cover this work before you quote, and show the licence number where your state requires it. Some work (for example gas, electrical and some plumbing or roofing) must be signed off by a licensed person. Your state regulator sets the rules; check them before relying on this guidance.
